item.title: San Jose daycare operator pleads guilty to toddler drowning deaths
item.description: A San Jose woman, Nina Fathizadeh, has pleaded guilty in connection with the 2023 drowning deaths of two toddlers at her family-run daycare.

item.title: Proposed legislation would create 'Bruce Lee Day' in California
item.description: A member of the California State Assembly has authored a bill that would establish May 17 as Bruce Lee Day, an annual, statewide observance honoring the San Francisco-born martial arts icon known for his roles in Enter the Dragon and Game of Death, among others.The bill, AB 2455, was authored by Matt Haney (D-San Francisco). item.title: Homes in this California county will soon be auctioned with bids as low as $100
item.description: Riverside County has greenlit a massive public auction of 946 tax-defaulted properties, with some minimum bids starting as low as $100.

item.title: Mountain View joins growing list of cities dumping Flock Safety cameras
item.description: The Mountain View City Council voted unanimously to end the city's contract with Flock Safety for automated license plate reading cameras on Tuesday. Mountain View now joins a growing list of cities that have ended contracts with or sued Flock Safety over data privacy concerns. Earlier this month, the Mountain View Chief of Police Mike Canfield informed residents that federal agencies had accessed the city's ALPR data against the city's policies.
